insights.title: PASSING EDGE
insights.short: MIZ pass O #36 vs ARK pass D #113; run O #113 vs run D #86.
insights.text: Missouri’s pass offense (#36 of 137) faces Arkansas’ pass defense (#113 of 138): a clear measured gap, in Missouri’s favour. On the ground, Missouri’s run offense (#113) meets Arkansas’ run defense (#86), where Arkansas ranks better. This gap is not in EdgeDesk’s number: its passing pairing gets no current-season data. Its matchup term, Missouri +0.6 here, moves through other pairings (across the slate, mostly ball control against front disruption and early-down success). Tested on games it was not fitted on, it helps a little, not yet significantly.
